rejected_designs.name: single_zero_time_pidfd_poll
rejected_designs.reason: Kernel reparents child before publishing parent exit_state; arm after reparent then poll before exit_state can miss death. Also pidfd_open requires Linux5.3 and conflicts with declared Debian10 baseline.

rejected_designs.name: bwrap_sync_fd
rejected_designs.reason: Inspected source does not preserve sync-fd in monitor whitelist and intentionally leaves it inside as-pid-1 sandbox path; wrong lifetime owner.

rejected_designs.name: simple_rearm_or_PPID0
rejected_designs.reason: Namespace PPID0 cannot distinguish original parent from already-reparented state; late rearm is not retroactive.

rejected_designs.name: remove_as_pid_1
rejected_designs.reason: Violates original seccomp-filtered reaper and orphan-reaping tests.

new_controls.early_case_limit: waitid observes real launcher terminal state before releasing probe; this tests already-dead/reparented original parent. The earlier PF_EXITING-before-zombie window is source reasoning, not a claimed physical runtime reproduction.
